exceptions.item: Assignment rubric on 'Rewrite a Workplace Email' (4 criteria, 12 levels)
exceptions.detail: Moodle rubric grading forms have no machine-readable equivalent in IMS Common Cartridge.
exceptions.fallback: Rubric criteria and level descriptions are reproduced as a readable table inside the assignment page; a human must rebuild the rubric in the target system's grading tool.

exceptions.item: SCORM 1.2 package 'scorm-missed-deadline.zip' (activity: Interactive Scenario: The Missed Deadline (SCORM 1.2))
exceptions.detail: Transferred byte-identical as a file. Its SCORM runtime wiring — launch settings and grade passback to the gradebook — cannot be verified from files alone and is NOT converted.
exceptions.fallback: Package file carried unchanged; a human must attach it with the target system's SCORM tool and test it in student view, including a completion/passback check.
